title: Give your AI agents a shared memory in Basecamp
summary: A writer set up one Basecamp project as shared memory for her AI agents, with an About doc, a set of rules and a daily cleanup run, and shares a prompt.
agent_role: Agents read and write to a shared Basecamp project and run a daily cleanup. The agent can also build the setup itself from the provided prompt.
what_they_did: The author built a shared memory for her AI agents inside Basecamp. It uses one project, one About document, one set of rules, and a daily cleanup run. She wrote up the setup with a prompt that has an agent build it.
prompt: Set up a shared memory for my AI agents in [project tool, e.g. Basecamp]. Create one project with an About document explaining what it is for, and one document of rules for how agents add and update notes. Then run a daily cleanup that merges duplicates and removes outdated notes. Show me the structure and rules first and wait for my approval before creating anything or deleting notes.

curation.rationale: Describes a specific setup for shared agent memory in Basecamp with a daily cleanup run and a paste-in prompt, but the post itself has few details beyond the linked article.
